tasks.short: Plan menus and guide food selection

steps.what: Clarify nutritional needs and select suitable foods under established guidelines
Calculate menu nutrients and compare totals with specified nutritional ranges
Review menu suitability and guide individuals or families in food selection and preparation

tasks.design: Use a configured nutrition calculator in {OTHER}, a nutrition planning system, for arithmetic over a technician-checked menu. Keep suitability review and individual guidance human, with dietitian instructions available in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated nutrient arithmetic competes with menu judgement and explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured food composition values can support fixed quantity calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Calculated nutrient totals do not establish allergy suitability, swallowing safety or clinical appropriateness.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding preferences, practical preparation and when to refer a question to the dietitian.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic; supervision and counselling responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss why a proposed menu may be impractical
reach.learn: Nutrient data limitations and referral boundaries

evidence.claim: NEVO-online provides food composition data usable as a source for nutrient calculations.
Configuring arithmetic over checked portions is plausible; local savings and clinical suitability remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers technician menu preparation and guidance under existing supervision; dietitian assessment, approval where required, and actual meal production remain separate and unchanged.

Dietitian supplies individual instructions before s1 in ordinary supervised care. Technician in s1 checks instruction version, dietary limits and units, food identity, preparation state, ingredient quantities, portions, preferences and current allergy information; uncertainty is clarified manually before calculation or referred.

Existing composition database publishes food ID, nutrient per reference quantity, units and version. Technician selects and verifies mappings in s1; unmatched foods remain manual. Calculation flags arithmetic range differences only, never a free clinical eligibility or safe-food flag.
Native calculator configuration is tested first; existing calculator runtime earns no saving. Individual questions arise during s3 and retain conversation time.
research_questions: Does the calculator reduce repeated nutrient arithmetic after portion capture and manual suitability review?

already_counted.description: Input capture, menu judgement, review and individual explanation

incremental.description: Maintain food mappings and calculation checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+40=80, gross=20, focal upkeep=8, net=12. Range 0-4 assumes repeated manual arithmetic on mapped foods; existing nutrition software or unmatched recipes remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify duties, supervision and requirements for job descriptions
Develop draft job specifications and descriptions from agreed responsibilities

loop.purpose: Draft role wording from the checked responsibilities
loop.input: Checked role brief and organisation's job template
loop.output: Draft description with source links for duties and qualifications
loop.check: Technician checks scope, supervision, workload and every qualification; unsupported obligations are removed
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unresolved scope returns to manager discussion
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative role wording requires interpretation; fixed merge fields cannot describe varied duties

steps.what: Check job specifications for service accuracy and hand off the proposal

tasks.design: For the job-description branch, test native drafting in {DOCS} using agreed responsibilities and the current template. The technician verifies the wording and hands a proposal to management; employment approval and publication retain their own time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated drafting can take time after role requirements are agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can organise supplied responsibilities into the existing template.
tasks.still_hard: Determining duties and qualification requirements needs service and personnel judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising unrealistic workload or responsibility beyond the role's supervised scope.
tasks.altitude: Less wording effort without taking employment approval rights.

evidence.claim: A checked role brief can support bounded job-description drafting; local labour savings are unmeasured.

assumptions: This is the job description/specification branch, not a combined saving on staff scheduling. Manager and HR approval, recruitment and roster work remain outside and unchanged.

Technician in s1 obtains and records duties, reporting role, supervised scope, work setting, hours assumptions, required versus desirable qualifications and template version. Manager clarifications are obtained during that discussion; missing requirements return there rather than being invented.
Native templates and drafting features are tested before custom code; no automatic employment record update is proposed.
research_questions: Does repeated wording work justify the draft after scope checking and upkeep?

already_counted.description: Brief capture, meaning checks and final service review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+40*0.65+25=86, gross=14, focal upkeep=6, net=8. Range 0-2 assumes recurring description revisions; infrequent bespoke roles may yield no gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Attend interdisciplinary meetings and discuss patient care with other professionals

tasks.design: Retain interdisciplinary participation and discussion with authorised access to the clinical record in {OTHER}. Check native record access if information retrieval is a separate burden; no unobserved minutes-writing baseline is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient care discussion combines different professional perspectives and emerging information.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access supports the conversation without replacing participation.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling nutrition needs with other care priorities and uncertainty.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining practical nutrition observations and recognising when specialist input is needed.

reach.task: Discuss barriers to following the nutrition plan

evidence.claim: The supplied GP scribe study reports unchanged consultation length; it does not establish savings in interdisciplinary meeting attendance.

assumptions: Boundary covers technician participation only; other professionals retain their meeting time and clinical authority.
OTHER is a clinical record system. Professionals supply observations during discussion; no machine assumes a ready structured patient-care decision or approved follow-up flag.
Check native record retrieval first if a separate problem emerges.
Zero incremental upkeep follows from introducing no new application or recording requirement.
unknowns: Separate meeting preparation and documentation workload
research_questions: Is any observed clerical work separate from essential care discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Attendance remains human; other professionals' time is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the research question and gather food and nutrition source material
Compare research findings and draft a cited evidence summary

loop.input: Selected publications and checked dietitian research question
loop.output: Evidence summary with source passages, study context, uncertainty and contradictions
loop.check: Technician opens every source, checks population, methods, quantities and whether conclusions exceed the findings
loop.stop: One draft and correction; missing evidence or unverifiable citations return to manual research
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative research findings need contextual comparison, not just structured lookup

steps.what: Explain research limits and provide the checked summary to the dietitian

tasks.design: Test native search in {DOCS} and use an optional bounded summary over selected publications. The technician checks every claim and explains limitations to the dietitian; clinical interpretation and treatment decisions retain their separate time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing narrative findings and tracing supporting passages is repetitive.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded language step can draft a cited comparison for checking.
tasks.still_hard: Study design, population and limitations determine whether a result is relevant.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising weak evidence and communicating uncertainty without overstating it.
tasks.altitude: Less comparison drafting, with unchanged advisory research scope.

reach.task: Discuss applicability of a study to service needs
reach.learn: Evidence appraisal and limits of extrapolation

evidence.claim: A bounded source-grounded research summary is plausible; the supplied clinical automation cases do not establish nutrition research savings.

assumptions: Boundary is technician research assistance through a checked brief; dietitian appraisal and any patient application remain outside and unchanged.

Dietitian provides the research question before s1. Technician in s1 locates and reads sources and records citation ID, date, relevant pages, study population and scope; extraction and permission checks retain all s1 time. Missing sources are sought manually or declared missing.
Native search is checked before custom orchestration; no invented citation, patient facts or prestructured literature feed is assumed.
research_questions: Does source verification and correction leave a net saving in repeated research summaries?

already_counted.description: Source capture, meaning verification and discussion

incremental.description: Maintain citation checks and research prompts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+40*0.65+20=86, gross=14, focal upkeep=7, net=7. Range 0-2 assumes accessible recurring literature comparisons; extensive new retrieval or methodological corrections remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains supervised nutrition judgement and patient discussion while testing arithmetic and bounded drafting support.
reach: Bring clearer research limitations and practical menu constraints to dietitians and care colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A technician who spends more time on practical, understandable nutrition guidance under dietitian supervision.
